response.sql: WITH scope_fees AS (SELECT u.acctscope, AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS avg_net_fee_rate, COUNT(*) AS fee_record_count FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY u.acctscope) SELECT acctscope, avg_net_fee_rate, fee_record_count, avg_net_fee_rate - AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) OVER () AS difference_from_scope_average FROM scope_fees

assumptions.assumption: A matched user with a NULL acctscope forms a group. The fee count includes records whose net rate is missing; AVG ignores those rates.

alternatives.sql: WITH scope_fees AS (SELECT u.acctscope, AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS avg_net_fee_rate, COUNT(*) AS fee_record_count FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp WHERE u.acctscope IS NOT NULL GROUP BY u.acctscope) SELECT acctscope, avg_net_fee_rate, fee_record_count, avg_net_fee_rate - AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) OVER () AS difference_from_scope_average FROM scope_fees
